name: Alcohol Vapor Gas Sensor
description: Chemical vapor nose! Uses a heated tin-dioxide element to detect alcohol vapors in air.
realWorldAnalogy: Chemical vapor nose! Uses a heated tin-dioxide element to detect alcohol vapors in air.

hazards: Heated metal mesh reaches high temperature (burn hazard)
safety.childSafeAlternative: Use rubbing alcohol swab at distance; never inhale

wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V (requires ~150mA current), GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and A0 (Yellow) to analog pin A0.
commonMistakes: Touching the heated metal casing while powered on (burn hazard).
Not waiting 2-3 minutes for the internal heater to reach operating temperature.

miniExperiment.title: Vapor Concentration Meter
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Outputs steady ambient readings (~50-150). Approaching with an alcohol swab causes readings to jump to 600+.
